correctness.rationale: Exact inverse-simplex continuity and idempotence give an established fixed-image fiber lemma. The four mutually exclusive hub/blade cases yield the explicit polynomial for every positive blade size. The equal-blade specialization and total mass follow algebraically. Nonnegative dominant term of mass ms b^(m-1) has relative omitted mass O(1/m) for fixed s>=2, yielding an iid CLT with explicit positive variance. Brute force checked all rank coefficients on nine graph configurations; the infinite result does not rely on finite experiments.

value.rationale: The full image-rank polynomial is a natural local structural statistic for graph-continuous monoids on one-hub clique sums. It extends the prior star enumeration to all heterogeneous clique windmills, cleanly isolates the one-hub coupling, and yields a new quantitative Gaussian fluctuation theorem (friendship mean m and variance m/3). This goes beyond a routine low-parameter table or a relabeling of the universal fiber lemma.
